_about: Hand-authored compaction evaluation corpus (REQ-PX-109, PX-138 groundwork). The probes are questions a continuing agent must still be able to answer after compaction; their answers are written here by a person from the transcript, independently of how the compactor labels facts. A probe is visible when its answer is in the epoch's context (the Core's segment plus the validated narrative) and recoverable when it is in the stored transcript the pointer names.
